articles.title: Priority Jewels shares to list today; GMP indicates potential 14% listing gains
articles.summary: Priority Jewels' Rs 91.05 crore Initial Public Offering (IPO) is scheduled to debut on the BSE and NSE on September 4, 2026. The public issue garnered an overwhelmingly strong response, being subscribed 100.45 times overall. This significant oversubscription highlights robust investor confidence in the company's market entry.

articles.title: Breaking news live updates: ISRO chief V Narayanan says Earth observation satellites are not ‘spy satellites’, scan India for citizen safety
articles.summary: ISRO chief V. Narayanan clarified that Earth observation satellites continuously scan India to bolster citizen safety and security, asserting they should not be termed "spy satellites." These crucial assets provide vital data for national benefit, aiding in various applications beyond mere surveillance, thereby enhancing India's strategic capabilities and ensuring the well-being of its population.

articles.title: Civil Aviation Minister welcomes Group Captain Abhinandan Varthaman to civil aviation
articles.summary: Group Captain Abhinandan Varthaman (Retd), a celebrated Indian Air Force pilot known for his courage, has transitioned into the civil aviation sector. This move marks a new career chapter for the decorated officer after his distinguished service. His decision was noted by the Civil Aviation Minister, highlighting opportunities for servicemen post-retirement and inspiring future defence aspirants.

articles.title: Lanterns Viewing Numbers Take Flight: S01E03 Averages 10M First 3 Days
articles.summary: HBO's 'Lanterns' series, featuring Aaron Pierre and Kyle Chandler, is reportedly attracting significant viewership, challenging some social media perceptions. This highlights the ongoing popularity of major international streaming content and potential disparities between online discourse and actual audience engagement with global entertainment productions.
